summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by SOLAI Ltd., a foreign private issuer, announcing the launch of its Solode Neo personal AI device. The press release describes a new product—a plug-and-play hardware device for autonomous AI agents—priced at US$399 with an early-bird price of US$369. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, activist campaign, or other special-situation event is disclosed. The filing is a routine product announcement with no financial terms, board actions, or structural changes. Accordingly, this is classified as a standard current report, not a special situation.
